title: Managed Database: standard unit rate
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database standard unit rate is specified by contracted tier. Standard primary usage rate in USD per primary usage unit before region factors; decimal.

| Contracted tier | Standard unit rate |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.186 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.372 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.744 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 1.488 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 2.976 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 5.952 |

## Hypothetical tier comparison
Hypothetical comparison limited to standard unit rate: choosing Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore instead of Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore changes this value from 0.186 to 5.952, a difference of 5.766. This comparison describes that parameter alone.
